requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete at least four upper division courses in a business concentration including at least three 400 division BUS courses, each worth a minimum of three units (excluding BUS 478 and practicum courses). 400 division BUS courses worth zero units cannot be used to fulfil this requirement.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least one of these 400 division BUS courses must be completed at Simon Fraser University.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students may choose to complete one or more business concentrations by meeting the concentration requirements listed on the business major page of the calendar.

sections.title: Mechatronic Systems Engineering Elective Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must also complete four mechatronic systems engineering elective courses selected from a pre-approved MSE electives list that is available at https://www.sfu.ca/mechatronics/current-students/undergraduate-students/undergraduate-program-requirements/technical-studies-electives.html.

sections.note:
With undergraduate curriculum committee chair permission, students may replace one MSE elective with either a directed study or a special project laboratory course.
Special topics courses that have been approved by the undergraduate curriculum committee chair and the director may be counted here.

sections.title: Elective Course Requirements
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

grades.label: Minimum Grade Requirements
grades.text: In addition to normal university grade point average requirements, the Beedie School of Business requires a minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average for entry into all 300 and 400 division business courses.

grades.label: Minimum Grade Requirements
grades.text: A minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average is required for graduation from a business major, joint major, or double degree program.
